body: Chart now supports selecting and comparing counter histories, daily/running totals, day/week/month aggregation, exact data, statistics and browser-local rate valuation. The 528-test full gate, release Chromium/WebKit Chart scenarios and affected navigation/counter/loading checks pass. The rebuilt existing HTTPS app verifies 36 assets while preserving 29 prior source versions, two pins, profile settings/roots/registrations, identity/epoch and certificate. Temporary synthetic histories were removed; existing counter histories were unchanged. Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-counter-chart.md. Physical-device and full-release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Implemented and verified the counter Chart dashboard
